description: This PHP source file defines the 'Schema' class implementing SQLite-specific database schema operations within Drupal, including table creation, alteration, indexing, and introspection.

classes.name: Schema
classes.description: A Drupal-specific implementation of the database schema for SQLite, handling table creation, modification, indexing, and schema introspection.

methods.name: tableExists
methods.description: Checks if a table exists in the SQLite database.

methods.name: fieldExists
methods.description: Checks if a specific field exists in a given table.

methods.name: createTableSql
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to create a new table with specified schema.

methods.name: createIndexSql
methods.description: Builds SQL statements for creating indexes and unique keys.

methods.name: createColumnsSql
methods.description: Creates SQL for defining columns in a table.

methods.name: createKeySql
methods.description: Builds SQL for key definitions.

methods.name: processField
methods.description: Sets database-specific properties for a field based on schema.

methods.name: createFieldSql
methods.description: Creates SQL string for a field to be used in table creation or alteration.

methods.name: getFieldTypeMap
methods.description: Returns a mapping of schema field types to SQLite data types.

methods.name: renameTable
methods.description: Renames a table in the SQLite database.

methods.name: dropTable
methods.description: Drops a table if it exists.

methods.name: addField
methods.description: Adds a new field to an existing table.

methods.name: alterTable
methods.description: Creates a new table with a new schema and copies data over for schema changes.

methods.name: dropField
methods.description: Removes a field from a table.

methods.name: changeField
methods.description: Changes the definition or name of a field in a table.

methods.name: mapKeyDefinition
methods.description: Renames columns in index definitions according to a new mapping.

methods.name: addIndex
methods.description: Adds an index to a table.

methods.name: indexExists
methods.description: Checks if an index exists on a table.

methods.name: dropIndex
methods.description: Drops an index from a table.

methods.name: addUniqueKey
methods.description: Adds a unique key constraint to a table.

methods.name: dropUniqueKey
methods.description: Removes a unique key constraint.

methods.name: addPrimaryKey
methods.description: Adds a primary key to a table.

methods.name: dropPrimaryKey
methods.description: Removes the primary key from a table.

methods.name: findPrimaryKeyColumns
methods.description: Retrieves primary key columns of a table.

methods.name: introspectIndexSchema
methods.description: Retrieves index schema details for a table.

methods.name: findTables
methods.description: Finds tables matching a pattern across attached databases.
